name: Mount Kongō
text: Mount Kongō (金剛山, Kongō-san) is a 1,125-metre-high (3,691 ft) mountain in the Kongō Range on the border of Nara Prefecture and the Kawachi region of Osaka Prefecture, in Kansai, Japan. The peak itself is in Nara Prefecture. It is near Mount Yamato Katsuragi.

depictions.name: Mount Kongo
depictions.text: Mount Kongō (金剛山) is a mountain located in the Kongō Range in the Kawachi region of Osaka Prefecture, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke climbed the mountain, went on a wayward tree, and oversaw the land.
